channel.desc: Join Curtis and Paula Eakins from Health Seminars, Inc. as they share practical health insights through their Winning Weigh Challenge! In the first hour, you'll be inspired by an informative interview packed with wellness tips. Then, step into the kitchen for the second hour as they prepare delicious, plant-based favorites like Tortilla Salad Bowls, Creamy Basil Dressing, Mock Tuna Sandwich Spread, Hearty Vegetable Soup, and a refreshing Strawberry Banana Sorbet.
